install.title: Installation
install.html:
Quick start

Scaffold a project with the server, worker, admin dashboard and GraphQL APIs ready to run:

npx @vendure/create my-shop

Requires Node.js 22.12+ (20.19+ still runs, but Node.js 20 is end-of-life) and a SQL database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or SQLite). The getting started guide covers configuration, seed data and your first plugin. Ask questions on our Discord.

Self-hosting

Vendure runs anywhere Node.js runs, including Docker, Kubernetes, a single VM or any cloud provider. Self-hosting is free, and your data stays in your own database. See the deployment guides.

Vendure Cloud

Vendure Cloud is the managed runtime for Vendure. It deploys on git push, creates a preview environment for every pull request, and manages the database, queues, search, backups and scaling. It runs the same application you can self-host, so you can move to Cloud without rebuilding it. Every paid plan includes Cloud at no extra cost. Cloud is in design-partner preview now, with general availability planned for Q1 2027.
